description: This file contains normalized CSS styles, primarily based on normalize.css, to provide consistent default styling across browsers. It sets default styles for HTML elements such as html, body, headings, hr, pre, a, abbr, b, strong, code, kbd, samp, small, sub, sup, img, form elements, fieldset, legend, progress, textarea, checkbox, radio buttons, search inputs, details, summary, template, and hidden elements, ensuring cross-browser consistency and establishing a baseline for styling.
